cue_3_4_sit_up_1: Lie down on the floor and secure your feet. Your legs should be bent at the knees.
cue_3_4_sit_up_2: Place your hands behind or to the side of your head. You will begin with your back on the ground. This will be your starting position.
cue_3_4_sit_up_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_90_90_hamstring_1: Lie on your back, with one leg extended straight out.
cue_90_90_hamstring_2: With the other leg, bend the hip and knee to 90 degrees. You may brace your leg with your hands if necessary. This will be your starting position.
cue_90_90_hamstring_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_ab_crunch_machine_1: Curl your ribcage toward your pelvis rather than pulling arms.
cue_ab_crunch_machine_2: Pause in full crunch contraction and control the return.
cue_ab_roller_1: Tuck pelvis under and brace abs before rolling forward.
cue_ab_roller_2: Roll only as far as your lower back stays flat, then pull back.
cue_ab_roller_mistake: Letting the hips sag and arching the lower back.
cue_adductor_1: Lie face down with one leg on a foam roll.
cue_adductor_2: Rotate the leg so that the foam roll contacts against your inner thigh. Shift as much weight onto the foam roll as can be tolerated.
cue_adductor_groin_1: Lie on your back with your feet raised towards the ceiling.
cue_adductor_groin_2: Have your partner hold your feet or ankles. Abduct your legs as far as you can. This will be your starting position.
cue_adductor_groin_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_adductor_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_advanced_kettlebell_windmill_1: Clean and press a kettlebell overhead with one arm.
cue_advanced_kettlebell_windmill_2: Keeping the kettlebell locked out at all times, push your butt out in the direction of the locked out kettlebell.
cue_advanced_kettlebell_windmill_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_air_bike_1: Keep shoulder blades lifted and rotate ribs, not elbows.
cue_air_bike_2: Extend the opposite leg cleanly on each twist.
cue_air_bike_mistake: Rushing fast and pulling on the neck.
cue_all_fours_quad_stretch_1: Start off on your hands and knees, then lift your leg off the floor and hold the foot with your hand.
cue_all_fours_quad_stretch_2: Use your hand to hold the foot or ankle, keeping the knee fully flexed, stretching the quadriceps and hip flexors.
cue_all_fours_quad_stretch_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_alternate_leg_diagonal_bound_1: Assume a comfortable stance with one foot slightly in front of the other.
cue_alternate_leg_diagonal_bound_2: Begin by pushing off with the front leg, driving the opposite knee forward and as high as possible before landing.
cue_alternate_leg_diagonal_bound_mistake: Losing posture or landing stiffly with locked knees.
cue_alternating_db_curl_1: Supinate your palm upward as you curl one arm at a time.
cue_alternating_db_curl_2: Finish lowering one arm before starting the next.
cue_alternating_db_curl_mistake: Twisting the torso with every rep.
cue_alternating_db_shoulder_press_1: Squeeze glutes and abs so your torso stays still.
cue_alternating_db_shoulder_press_2: Press one arm overhead while stabilizing the other.
cue_alternating_db_shoulder_press_mistak: Leaning side to side with each rep.
cue_alternating_deltoid_raise_1: In a standing position, hold a pair of dumbbells at your side.
cue_alternating_deltoid_raise_2: Keeping your elbows slightly bent, raise the weights directly in front of you to shoulder height, avoiding any swinging or cheating.
cue_alternating_deltoid_raise_mistake: Arching the lower back excessively instead of bracing.
cue_alternating_floor_press_1: Lie on the floor with two kettlebells next to your shoulders.
cue_alternating_floor_press_2: Position one in place on your chest and then the other, gripping the kettlebells on the handle with the palms facing forward.
cue_alternating_floor_press_mistake: Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_alternating_hammer_curl_1: Keep thumbs pointing up throughout the rep.
cue_alternating_hammer_curl_2: Control the lowering phase to load the forearms.
cue_alternating_hammer_curl_mistake: Swinging the shoulder forward at the top.
cue_alternating_hang_clean_1: Place two kettlebells between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt back and look straight ahead.
cue_alternating_hang_clean_2: Clean one kettlebell to your shoulder and hold on to the other kettlebell in a hanging position.
cue_alternating_hang_clean_mistake: Rounding the lower back under load.
cue_ankle_circles_1: Use a sturdy object like a squat rack to hold yourself.
cue_ankle_circles_2: Lift the right leg in the air (just around 2 inches from the floor) and perform a circular motion with the big toe.
cue_ankle_circles_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_anterior_tibialis_smr_1: Begin seated on the ground with your legs bent and your feet on the floor.
cue_anterior_tibialis_smr_2: Using a Muscle Roller or a rolling pin, apply pressure to the muscles on the outside of your shins.
cue_anterior_tibialis_smr_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_anti_gravity_press_1: Place a bar on the ground behind the head of an incline bench.
cue_anti_gravity_press_2: Lay on the bench face down. With a pronated grip, pick the barbell up from the floor.
cue_anti_gravity_press_mistake: Arching the lower back excessively instead of bracing.
cue_archer_pull_up_1: Take a wide grip and pull toward one hand.
cue_archer_pull_up_2: Keep the other arm straight along the bar, then switch sides.
cue_archer_pull_up_mistake: Twisting the body or bending the straight arm.
cue_archer_push_up_1: Set the hands very wide and lower toward one hand.
cue_archer_push_up_2: Keep the other arm straight, press up, then switch sides.
cue_archer_push_up_mistake: Turning the hips or bending the straight arm.
cue_arm_circles_1: Stand up and extend your arms straight out by the sides. The arms should be parallel to the floor and perpendicular (90-degree angle) to your torso.
cue_arm_circles_2: Slowly start to make circles of about 1 foot in diameter with each outstretched arm. Breathe normally as you perform the movement.
cue_arm_circles_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_arnold_press_1: Start with palms facing you at upper chest height.
cue_arnold_press_2: Rotate wrists outward smoothly as you press overhead.
cue_arnold_press_mistake: Rushing the rotation or slamming weights together.
cue_around_the_worlds_1: Lay down on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand with the palms of the hands facing towards the ceiling.
cue_around_the_worlds_2: Now move the dumbbells by creating a semi-circle as you displace them from the initial position to over the head.
cue_around_the_worlds_mistake: Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_australian_chin_up_1: Pull the chest to the bar with palms facing you.
cue_australian_chin_up_2: Keep the elbows close and the body in one line.
cue_australian_chin_up_mistake: Jerking up with the hips instead of the arms.
cue_australian_pull_up_1: Pull the chest to the bar with the body in one line.
cue_australian_pull_up_2: Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top.
cue_australian_pull_up_mistake: Letting the hips sag as you pull.
cue_back_extension_1: Lift until the body is in a straight line.
cue_back_extension_2: Squeeze the glutes and lower slowly.
cue_back_extension_mistake: Swinging up and arching the lower back.
cue_back_flyes_with_bands_1: Run a band around a stationary post like that of a squat rack.
cue_back_flyes_with_bands_2: Grab the band by the handles and stand back so that the tension in the band rises.
cue_back_flyes_with_bands_mistake: Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_back_lever_tuck_1: Keep the arms straight and open the shoulders gently.
cue_back_lever_tuck_2: Tuck the knees and hold the body steady.
cue_back_lever_tuck_mistake: Forcing the shoulders into a deep stretch.
cue_back_squat_1: Brace the core and keep the bar over the mid-foot.
cue_back_squat_2: Sit down between the hips and drive up through the whole foot.
cue_back_squat_mistake: Letting the knees cave in or the chest drop.
cue_backward_medicine_ball_throw_1: This exercise is best done with a partner. If you lack a partner, the ball can be thrown and retrieved or thrown against a wall.
cue_backward_medicine_ball_throw_2: Begin standing a few meters in front of your partner, both facing the same direction. Begin holding the ball between your legs.
cue_backward_medicine_ball_throw_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_balance_board_1: Place a balance board in front of you.
cue_balance_board_2: Stand up on it and try to balance yourself.
cue_balance_board_mistake: Bouncing quickly through the bottom without a pause.
cue_ball_leg_curl_1: Begin on the floor laying on your back with your feet on top of the ball.
cue_ball_leg_curl_2: Position the ball so that when your legs are extended your ankles are on top of the ball. This will be your starting position.
cue_ball_leg_curl_mistake: Lifting hips off the pad to finish the rep.
cue_band_assisted_pull_up_1: Loop a band over the bar and put one foot or knee in it.
cue_band_assisted_pull_up_2: Pull the chest to the bar and lower slowly to straight arms.
cue_band_assisted_pull_up_mistake: Dropping fast and bouncing out of the band.
cue_band_calf_raise_1: Loop the band around the ball of your foot while seated.
cue_band_calf_raise_2: Press toes forward against tension and return slowly.
cue_band_calf_raise_mistake: Snapping the foot back without control.
cue_band_chest_press_1: Anchor the band behind you and press straight out.
cue_band_chest_press_2: Keep the shoulders down and return slowly.
cue_band_curl_1: Stand on the band and keep the elbows pinned.
cue_band_curl_mistake: Swinging the torso to stretch the band.
cue_band_dorsiflexion_1: Anchor the band and pull the toes toward the shin.
cue_band_dorsiflexion_2: Move the foot only, keeping the leg still.
cue_band_dorsiflexion_mistake: Rocking the whole leg to move the band.
cue_band_external_rotation_1: Pin elbow to your side at 90 degrees (tuck a towel if helpful).
cue_band_external_rotation_2: Rotate forearm outward slowly without moving the elbow.
cue_band_external_rotation_mistake: Twisting the torso or drifting the elbow away.
cue_band_good_morning_1: Loop band under feet and across upper back (never neck).
cue_band_good_morning_2: Push hips back with a flat spine, then squeeze glutes up.
cue_band_good_morning_mistake: Rounding the upper back under band pull.
cue_band_good_morning_pull_through_1: Loop the band around a post. Standing a little ways away, loop the opposite end around the neck. Your hands can help hold the band in position.
cue_band_good_morning_pull_through_2: Begin by bending at the hips, getting your butt back as far as possible. Keep your back flat and bend forward to about 90 degrees.
cue_band_good_morning_pull_through_mista: Rounding the lower back under load.
cue_band_hip_adduction_1: Pull the leg inward against the band, hips level.
cue_band_hip_adduction_2: Control the return and keep the torso still.
cue_band_hip_adduction_mistake: Leaning to the side to move the leg.
cue_band_lateral_raise_1: Stand on the center of the band with soft knees.
cue_band_lateral_raise_2: Raise arms out to the sides against steady tension.
cue_band_lateral_raise_mistake: Letting the band snap your hands back down.
cue_band_leg_curl_1: Anchor the band and curl the heel toward the glutes.
cue_band_leg_curl_2: Control the return and keep the hips still.
cue_band_leg_curl_mistake: Letting the hips swing to move the band.
cue_band_overhead_triceps_1: Anchor the band under your rear foot in a staggered stance.
cue_band_overhead_triceps_2: Keep elbows close to your head and extend smoothly.
cue_band_overhead_triceps_mistake: Arching your back or flaring elbows wide.
cue_band_pull_apart_1: Pull the band apart at chest height with straight arms.
cue_band_pull_apart_mistake: Shrugging the shoulders as you pull.
cue_band_row_1: Sit tall and pull the band to the lower ribs.
cue_band_row_2: Squeeze the shoulder blades, then return slowly.
cue_band_row_mistake: Leaning back to pull the band.
cue_band_shoulder_press_1: Stand on the band with elbows tucked slightly forward.
cue_band_shoulder_press_2: Press overhead cleanly without arching the lower back.
cue_band_skull_crusher_1: Anchor band behind the bench and keep upper arms vertical.
cue_band_skull_crusher_2: Extend elbows cleanly without moving upper arms.
cue_band_skull_crusher_mistake: Letting upper arms drift toward your knees.
cue_band_squat_1: Stand on the band shoulder-width and loop ends at shoulders.
cue_band_squat_2: Sit down smoothly and drive knees out against tension.
cue_band_squat_mistake: Letting knees cave inward as you stand.
cue_band_upright_row_1: Stand on the band with hands shoulder-width apart.
cue_band_upright_row_2: Lead with elbows up to chest level, keeping wrists straight.
cue_barbell_ab_rollout_1: Kneel behind a barbell with round plates and brace hard.
cue_barbell_ab_rollout_2: Roll out under control keeping arms straight, then pull with abs.
cue_barbell_ab_rollout_mistake: Sitting hips back first instead of leading with hips and chest.
cue_barbell_calf_raise_1: Rest bar across upper traps and stand on a plate or block.
cue_barbell_calf_raise_2: Pause for 1 second at both the bottom stretch and top squeeze.
cue_barbell_calf_raise_mistake: Bouncing up and down without full range.
cue_barbell_curl_1: Keep the elbows at the sides and curl with control.
cue_barbell_curl_mistake: Rocking the torso to lift the bar.
cue_barbell_curls_lying_against_an_incli: Lie against an incline bench, with your arms holding a barbell and hanging down in a horizontal line. This will be your starting position.

cue_barbell_floor_press_2: Pause briefly without relaxing tension, then press.
cue_barbell_floor_press_mistake: Bouncing your elbows hard off the floor.
cue_barbell_glute_bridge_1: Lie flat on the floor with bar padded over your hip crease.

cue_barbell_glute_bridge_mistake: Hyperextending the lower back at the top.

cue_barbell_hack_squat_1: Stand in front of the bar and grip behind your thighs.
cue_barbell_hack_squat_2: Keep chest proud and drive knees forward as you squat.
cue_barbell_hack_squat_mistake: Letting the upper back round forward.
cue_barbell_incline_shoulder_raise_1: Lie back on an Incline Bench.

cue_barbell_lunge_1: Step forward cleanly with torso tall and core braced.
cue_barbell_lunge_2: Lower until both knees bend near 90 degrees, then push back.
cue_barbell_lunge_mistake: Letting the front knee collapse inward.
cue_barbell_pullover_1: Grip shoulder-width with a soft bend in the elbows.

cue_barbell_pullover_mistake: Dropping too far and straining the shoulders.
cue_barbell_rear_delt_row_1: Stand up straight while holding a barbell using a wide (higher than shoulder width) and overhand (palms facing your body) grip.

cue_barbell_row_1: Hinge forward with a flat back and pull to the lower ribs.
cue_barbell_row_2: Keep the elbows close and squeeze the shoulder blades.
cue_barbell_row_mistake: Standing up with each rep or rounding the back.
cue_barbell_seated_calf_raise_1: Place a block about 12 inches in front of a flat bench.

cue_barbell_seated_calf_raise_mistake: Bouncing quickly through the bottom without a pause.
cue_barbell_shoulder_press_1: Sit on a bench with back support in a squat rack. Position a barbell at a height that is just above your head.

cue_barbell_shoulder_press_mistake: Arching the lower back excessively instead of bracing.

cue_barbell_shrug_2: Hold at the top for a second before lowering slowly.
cue_barbell_side_bend_1: Place a light bar across traps and brace hips steady.

cue_barbell_walking_lunge_2: Drive smoothly through the front foot into the next step.
cue_barbell_walking_lunge_mistake: Walking on a tightrope and losing balance.

cue_battle_ropes_mistake: Standing upright or letting shoulders hunch forward.

cue_behind_back_shrug_2: Shrug straight up and squeeze the upper traps.
cue_behind_back_shrug_mistake: Bending the elbows or leaning forward.
cue_behind_head_chest_stretch_1: Sit upright on the floor with your partner behind you.
cue_behind_head_chest_stretch_2: Place your hands behind your hand, and push your elbows back as far as you can. Your partner should hold your elbows. This will be your starting position.
cue_behind_head_chest_stretch_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_bench_dip_1: Keep torso close to the bench with shoulders down.
cue_bench_dip_2: Lower until upper arms are parallel to the floor.
cue_bench_dip_mistake: Rolling shoulders forward or dropping too deep.
cue_bench_jump_1: Begin with a box or bench 1-2 feet in front of you. Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
cue_bench_jump_2: Perform a short squat in preparation for the jump; swing your arms behind you.
cue_bench_jump_mistake: Losing posture or landing stiffly with locked knees.
cue_bench_press_1: Plant the feet and keep the shoulder blades squeezed together.
cue_bench_press_2: Lower the bar to the mid-chest and press up in a line.
cue_bench_press_mistake: Bouncing the bar or lifting the hips off the bench.
cue_bench_press_with_chains_1: Adjust the leader chain, shortening it to the desired length. Place the chains on the sleeves of the bar.
cue_bench_press_with_chains_2: Lying on the bench, get your head beyond the bar if possible. Tuck your feet underneath you and arch your back.
cue_bench_press_with_chains_mistake: Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_bench_sprint_1: Stand on the ground with one foot resting on a bench or box with your heel close to the edge.
cue_bench_sprint_2: Push off with your foot on top of the bench, extending through the hip and knee.
cue_bench_sprint_mistake: Losing posture or landing stiffly with locked knees.
cue_bent_knee_hip_raise_1: Lay flat on the floor with your arms next to your sides.
cue_bent_knee_hip_raise_2: Now bend your knees at around a 75 degree angle and lift your feet off the floor by around 2 inches.
cue_bent_knee_hip_raise_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_bent_leg_bench_dip_1: Keep the elbows pointing back and close to the body.
cue_bent_leg_bench_dip_2: Lower until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
cue_bent_leg_bench_dip_mistake: Flaring the elbows out or dropping too deep.
cue_bent_over_cable_rear_fly_1: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding opposite low cables.
cue_bent_over_cable_rear_fly_2: Sweep arms out to the sides squeezing the rear delts.
cue_bent_over_cable_rear_fly_mistake: Rising up out of the hip hinge.
cue_bent_over_dumbbell_rear_delt_raise_w: Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell in each hand and with an incline bench in front of you.
While keeping your back straight and maintaining the natural arch of your back, lean forward until your forehead touches the bench in front of you.
Using heavy momentum instead of squeezing the upper back.
cue_bent_over_two_arm_long_bar_row_1: Put weight on one of the ends of an Olympic barbell.
cue_bent_over_two_arm_long_bar_row_2: Bend forward until your torso is as close to parallel with the floor as you can and keep your knees slightly bent.
cue_bent_over_two_arm_long_bar_row_mista: Rounding the upper back or jerking the weight.
cue_bent_over_two_dumbbell_row_with_palm: With a dumbbell in each hand (palms facing each other), bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor.

Rounding the upper back or jerking the weight.
cue_bent_press_1: Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder.
cue_bent_press_2: Begin my leaning to the side opposite the kettlebell, continuing until you are able to touch the ground with your free hand, keeping your eyes on the kettlebell.
cue_bent_press_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_bicep_curl_1: Keep the elbows pinned at your sides.
cue_bicep_curl_2: Curl up and lower slowly under control.
cue_bicep_curl_machine_1: Align your elbow joints with the machine's pivot axis.
cue_bicep_curl_machine_2: Curl smoothly and avoid slamming the stack.
cue_bicep_curl_machine_mistake: Lifting elbows off the arm pad.
cue_bicep_curl_mistake: Swinging the torso to lift the weight.
cue_biceps_wall_stretch_1: Place the palm on a wall behind you with the arm straight.
cue_biceps_wall_stretch_2: Turn the body slowly away until the arm feels long.
cue_biceps_wall_stretch_mistake: Cranking the shoulder into a sharp pull.
cue_bicycle_crunch_1: Rotate the ribs toward the opposite knee.
cue_bicycle_crunch_2: Move slowly and keep the lower back down.
cue_bicycle_crunch_mistake: Pulling on the neck and rushing the reps.
cue_bicycling_1: To begin, seat yourself on the bike and adjust the seat to your height.
cue_bicycling_2: Move through a controlled full range of motion.
cue_bicycling_mistake: Losing posture or landing stiffly with locked knees.
cue_bicycling_stationary_1: To begin, seat yourself on the bike and adjust the seat to your height.
cue_bicycling_stationary_2: Select the desired option from the menu. You may have to start pedaling to turn it on. You can use the manual setting, or you can select a program to use.
cue_bicycling_stationary_mistake: Losing posture or landing stiffly with locked knees.
cue_bird_dog_1: Reach the opposite arm and leg long, hips level.
cue_bird_dog_2: Move slowly and keep the spine still.
cue_bird_dog_mistake: Rotating the hips as the leg lifts.
cue_board_press_1: Begin by lying on the bench, getting your head beyond the bar if possible.
cue_board_press_2: Tuck your feet underneath you and arch your back.
cue_board_press_mistake: Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_body_tricep_press_1: Position a bar in a rack at chest height.
cue_body_tricep_press_2: Standing, take a shoulder width grip on the bar and step a yard or two back, feet together and arms extended so that you are leaning on the bar.
cue_body_tricep_press_mistake: Letting elbows flare or drift during the press.
cue_body_up_1: Assume a plank position on the ground. You should be supporting your bodyweight on your toes and forearms, keeping your torso straight.
cue_body_up_2: Pressing your palms firmly into the ground, extend through the elbows to raise your body from the ground. Keep your torso rigid as you perform the movement.
cue_body_up_mistake: Letting elbows flare or drift during the press.
cue_bodyweight_flyes_1: Position two equally loaded EZ bars on the ground next to each other. Ensure they are able to roll.
cue_bodyweight_flyes_2: Assume a push-up position over the bars, supporting your weight on your toes and hands with your arms extended and body straight.
cue_bodyweight_flyes_mistake: Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_bodyweight_walking_lunge_1: Keep torso upright and step forward at hip width.
cue_bodyweight_walking_lunge_2: Lower back knee softly before pushing through front heel.
cue_bodyweight_walking_lunge_mistake: Letting front knee drift sharply inward.
cue_bosu_ball_cable_crunch_with_side_ben: Connect a standard handle to each arm of a cable machine, and position them in the most downward position.
Grab a Bosu Ball and position it in front and center of the cable machine.
Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_bottoms_up_1: Begin by lying on your back on the ground. Your legs should be straight and your arms at your side. This will be your starting position.
cue_bottoms_up_2: To perform the movement, tuck the knees toward your chest by flexing the hips and knees.
cue_bottoms_up_clean_from_the_hang_posit: Initiate the exercise by standing upright with a kettlebell in one hand.
Swing the kettlebell back forcefully and then reverse the motion forcefully.
Rounding the lower back under load.
cue_bottoms_up_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_box_jump_1: Swing arms back, load hips, and land softly on the box.
cue_box_jump_2: Stand up tall on top, then step down safely one foot at a time.
cue_box_jump_mistake: Jumping backwards off high boxes or landing with knees caved.
cue_box_jump_multiple_response_1: Assume a relaxed stance facing the box or platform approximately an arm's length away. Arms should be down at the sides and legs slightly bent.
cue_box_jump_multiple_response_2: Using the arms to aid in the initial burst, jump upward and forward, landing with feet simultaneously on top of the box or platform.
cue_box_jump_multiple_response_mistake: Losing posture or landing stiffly with locked knees.
cue_box_skip_1: You will need several boxes lined up about 8 feet apart.
cue_box_skip_2: Begin facing the first box with one leg slightly behind the other.
cue_box_skip_mistake: Losing posture or landing stiffly with locked knees.
cue_box_squat_1: Sit hips back smoothly onto the box with shins near vertical.
cue_box_squat_2: Pause softly without relaxing your core, then explode up.
cue_box_squat_mistake: Plopping hard onto the box and rounding your back.
cue_box_squat_with_bands_1: Begin in a power rack with a box at the appropriate height behind you.
cue_box_squat_with_bands_2: Begin by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the shoulders.
cue_box_squat_with_bands_mistake: Letting knees cave inward or heels lift off the floor.
cue_box_squat_with_chains_1: Begin in a power rack with a box at the appropriate height behind you.
cue_box_squat_with_chains_2: To set up the chains, begin by looping the leader chain over the sleeves of the bar. The heavy chain should be attached using a snap hook.
cue_box_squat_with_chains_mistake: Letting knees cave inward or heels lift off the floor.
cue_brachialis_smr_1: Lie on your side, with your upper arm against the foam roller.
cue_brachialis_smr_2: Raise your hips off of the floor, supporting your weight on your arm and on your feet. Hold for 10-30 seconds, and then switch sides.
cue_brachialis_smr_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_bradford_rocky_presses_1: Sit on a Military Press Bench with a bar at shoulder level with a pronated grip (palms facing forward).
cue_bradford_rocky_presses_2: Once you pick up the barbell with the correct grip, lift the bar up over your head by locking your arms.
cue_bradford_rocky_presses_mistake: Arching the lower back excessively instead of bracing.
cue_bulgarian_split_squat_1: Lower straight down with most of the weight on the front foot.
cue_bulgarian_split_squat_2: Keep the torso tall and the front heel planted.
cue_bulgarian_split_squat_mistake: Standing too close so the front knee runs far ahead.
cue_burpee_1: Keep your core tight as you drop to the floor.
cue_burpee_2: Land softly and stand up fully before the next rep.
cue_burpee_mistake: Letting the lower back sag in the push-up position.
cue_butt_ups_1: Begin a pushup position but with your elbows on the ground and resting on your forearms. Your arms should be bent at a 90 degree angle.
cue_butt_ups_2: Arch your back slightly out rather than keeping your back completely straight.
cue_butt_ups_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_butterfly_stretch_1: Sit tall with the soles of the feet together and knees open.
cue_butterfly_stretch_2: Hinge forward from the hips with a long spine.
cue_butterfly_stretch_mistake: Bouncing the knees to push them down.
cue_cable_chest_press_1: Set pulleys at chest height and brace your core.
cue_cable_chest_press_2: Press handles forward together without rounding shoulders.
cue_cable_chest_press_mistake: Leaning forward to push heavy weight.
cue_cable_crossover_high_to_low_1: Set the pulleys high and step forward with a slight lean.
cue_cable_crossover_high_to_low_2: Bring the hands down and together in front of the hips.
cue_cable_crossover_high_to_low_mistake: Pressing with bent elbows instead of sweeping in an arc.
cue_cable_crossover_low_to_high_1: Set the pulleys low and hold the handles by the hips.
cue_cable_crossover_low_to_high_2: Sweep the hands up and together to chin height.
cue_cable_crossover_low_to_high_mistake: Shrugging the shoulders up to finish the rep.
cue_cable_crunch_1: Curl the ribs toward the hips with the hips still.
cue_cable_crunch_2: Exhale at the bottom and return slowly.
cue_cable_crunch_mistake: Pulling with the arms or sitting back on the hips.
cue_cable_curl_1: Keep the elbows at the sides and curl up.
cue_cable_curl_2: Squeeze at the top and lower with control.
cue_cable_curl_mistake: Leaning back to get the cable up.
cue_cable_deadlifts_1: Move the cables to the bottom of the towers and select an appropriate weight. Stand directly in between the uprights.
cue_cable_deadlifts_2: To begin, squat down be flexing your hips and knees until you can reach the handles.
cue_cable_deadlifts_mistake: Rounding the lower back under load.
cue_cable_external_rotation_1: Set pulley at elbow height and pin your elbow to your ribs.
cue_cable_external_rotation_2: Rotate forearm smoothly outward and control the return.
cue_cable_external_rotation_mistake: Using heavy weight that forces shoulder shrug.
cue_cable_fly_1: Keep a slight bend in the elbows and sweep a wide arc.
cue_cable_fly_2: Squeeze the chest and return slowly.
cue_cable_fly_mistake: Turning it into a press by bending the arms.
cue_cable_front_raise_1: Face away from the pulley with cable between legs or at your side.
cue_cable_front_raise_2: Raise to shoulder level with minimal body sway.
cue_cable_front_raise_mistake: Leaning back to finish the lift.
cue_cable_glute_kickback_1: Strap the cable to one ankle and hold the frame.
cue_cable_glute_kickback_2: Drive the leg straight back and squeeze the glute at the top.
cue_cable_glute_kickback_mistake: Arching the lower back to swing the leg higher.
cue_cable_hip_adduction_1: Attach ankle cuff low and hold the frame for balance.
cue_cable_hip_adduction_2: Sweep the working leg smoothly across your standing leg.
cue_cable_hip_adduction_mistake: Tilting your torso sideways as the leg moves.
cue_cable_incline_pushdown_1: Lie on incline an bench facing away from a high pulley machine that has a straight bar attachment on it.
cue_cable_incline_pushdown_2: Grasp the straight bar attachment overhead with a pronated (overhand; palms down) shoulder width grip and extend your arms in front of you.
cue_cable_incline_pushdown_mistake: Letting elbows flare or drift during the press.
cue_cable_incline_triceps_extension_1: Lie on incline an bench facing away from a high pulley machine that has a straight bar attachment on it.
cue_cable_incline_triceps_extension_2: Grasp the straight bar attachment overhead with a pronated (overhand; palms down) narrow grip (less than shoulder width) and keep your elbows tucked in to your sides.
cue_cable_incline_triceps_extension_mist: Letting elbows flare or drift during the press.
cue_cable_internal_rotation_1: Sit next to a low pulley sideways (with legs stretched in front of you or crossed) and grasp the single hand cable attachment with the arm nearest to the cable.
cue_cable_internal_rotation_2: Position the elbow against your side with the elbow bent at 90° and the arm pointing towards the pulley. This will be your starting position.
cue_cable_internal_rotation_mistake: Arching the lower back excessively instead of bracing.
cue_cable_iron_cross_1: Begin by moving the pulleys to the high position, select the resistance to be used, and take a handle in each hand.
cue_cable_iron_cross_2: Stand directly between both pulleys with your arms extended out to your sides. Your head and chest should be up while your arms form a "T".
cue_cable_iron_cross_mistake: Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_cable_judo_flip_1: Connect a rope attachment to a tower, and move the cable to the lowest pulley position.
cue_cable_judo_flip_2: Twist your body away from the pulley as you bring the rope over your shoulder like you're performing a judo flip.
cue_cable_judo_flip_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_cable_lateral_raise_1: Lead with the elbow and lift out to the side.
cue_cable_lateral_raise_2: Stop at shoulder height and lower slowly.
cue_cable_lateral_raise_mistake: Shrugging the shoulder toward the ear.
cue_cable_lying_tricep_ext_1: Lie on a flat bench facing away from a low pulley.
cue_cable_lying_tricep_ext_2: Bend elbows toward your forehead and press out smoothly.
cue_cable_lying_tricep_ext_mistake: Moving upper arms forward and backward.
cue_cable_preacher_curl_1: Keep elbows anchored on the pad for constant cable tension.
cue_cable_preacher_curl_2: Curl smoothly and lower under control.
cue_cable_preacher_curl_mistake: Letting the stack slam at the bottom.
cue_cable_pull_through_1: Hinge the hips back and drive them forward to stand.
cue_cable_pull_through_2: Keep the back flat and the arms loose.
cue_cable_pull_through_mistake: Squatting and pulling with the arms.
cue_cable_rear_delt_fly_1: Cross the cables at shoulder height and hold one in each hand.
cue_cable_rear_delt_fly_2: Sweep the arms out and back with a slight bend in the elbows.
cue_cable_rear_delt_fly_mistake: Shrugging or bending the elbows into a row.
cue_cable_reverse_crunch_1: Attach ankles to the low cable and hold the bench behind head.
cue_cable_reverse_crunch_2: Curl knees and pelvis upward off the bench.
cue_cable_reverse_crunch_mistake: Swinging straight legs down to arch your lower back.
cue_cable_rope_hammer_curl_1: Pin elbows at your sides and hold the rope neutrally.
cue_cable_rope_hammer_curl_2: Curl up toward shoulders and pause with tension.
cue_cable_rope_hammer_curl_mistake: Stepping too close or leaning back.
cue_cable_rope_rear_delt_row_1: Pull the rope toward your upper chest with high elbows.
cue_cable_rope_rear_delt_row_2: Keep wrists neutral and pinch shoulder blades together.
cue_cable_rope_rear_delt_row_mistake: Dropping elbows low into a lat row.
cue_cable_russian_twists_1: Connect a standard handle attachment, and position the cable to a middle pulley position.
cue_cable_russian_twists_2: Lie on a stability ball perpendicular to the cable and grab the handle with one hand.
cue_cable_russian_twists_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_cable_seated_crunch_1: Anchor feet and keep rope handles fixed beside your shoulders.
cue_cable_seated_crunch_2: Crunch ribs down toward your lap and exhale.
cue_cable_seated_crunch_mistake: Hinging at the hips with a stiff back.
cue_cable_shoulder_press_1: Keep elbows slightly forward under the handles.
cue_cable_shoulder_press_2: Press smoothly overhead and control the negative.
cue_cable_shoulder_press_mistake: Arching the lower back when pushing.
cue_cable_shrug_1: Stand tall holding a low straight bar attachment.
cue_cable_shrug_2: Pull shoulders straight toward your ears under tension.
cue_cable_shrug_mistake: Bending the arms to lift heavier weight.
cue_cable_side_bend_1: Stand sideways to a low or high pulley with torso tall.
cue_cable_side_bend_2: Flex purely sideways without twisting or leaning forward.
cue_cable_side_bend_mistake: Pulling with the shoulder instead of the obliques.
cue_cable_woodchop_1: Rotate through the torso and pivot the back foot.
cue_cable_woodchop_2: Keep the arms long and move with control.
cue_cable_woodchop_mistake: Using only the arms and not the core.
cue_cable_wrist_curl_1: Start out by placing a flat bench in front of a low pulley cable that has a straight bar attachment.
cue_cable_wrist_curl_2: Use your arms to grab the cable bar with a narrow to shoulder width supinated grip (palms up) and bring them up so that your forearms are resting against the top of your thighs.
cue_cable_wrist_curl_mistake: Swinging the elbows forward to heave the weight.
cue_calf_machine_shoulder_shrug_1: Position yourself on the calf machine so that the shoulder pads are above your shoulders.
cue_calf_machine_shoulder_shrug_2: Raise your shoulders up towards your ears as you exhale and hold the contraction for a full second.
cue_calf_machine_shoulder_shrug_mistake: Using heavy momentum instead of squeezing the upper back.
cue_calf_press_1: Adjust the seat so that your legs are only slightly bent in the start position. The balls of your feet should be firmly on the platform.
cue_calf_press_2: Select an appropriate weight, and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position.
cue_calf_press_mistake: Bouncing quickly through the bottom without a pause.
cue_calf_raise_1: Rise as high as you can and pause at the top.
cue_calf_raise_2: Lower slowly until the heels dip below the step.
cue_calf_raise_mistake: Bouncing quickly through a short range.
cue_calf_raise_on_a_dumbbell_1: Hang on to a sturdy object for balance and stand on a dumbbell handle, preferably one with round plates so that it rolls as in this manner you have to work harder to stabilize yourself; thus increasing the effectiveness of the exercise.
cue_calf_raise_on_a_dumbbell_2: Now roll your foot slightly forward so that you can get a nice stretch of the calf. This will be your starting position.
cue_calf_raise_on_a_dumbbell_mistake: Bouncing quickly through the bottom without a pause.
cue_calf_raise_turned_out_1: Turn the toes out and rise as high as you can.
cue_calf_raise_turned_out_2: Pause at the top and lower slowly.
cue_calf_raise_turned_out_mistake: Rolling the ankles outward instead of rising straight.
cue_calf_stretch_1: Press the back heel into the floor with the knee straight.
cue_calf_stretch_2: Lean into the wall until the calf feels long.
cue_calf_stretch_elbows_against_wall_1: Stand facing a wall from a couple feet away.
cue_calf_stretch_elbows_against_wall_2: Lean against the wall, placing your weight on your forearms.
cue_calf_stretch_elbows_against_wall_mis: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_calf_stretch_mistake: Letting the back heel lift off the floor.
cue_calves_smr_1: Begin seated on the floor. Place a foam roller underneath your lower leg.
cue_calves_smr_2: Place your hands to your side or just behind you, and press down to raise your hips off of the floor, placing much of your weight against your calf muscle.
cue_calves_smr_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_cambered_bar_row_1: Lie face down on an elevated bench with feet braced.
cue_cambered_bar_row_2: Pull the bar up until it touches the underside of the bench.
cue_cambered_bar_row_mistake: Jerking the chest up off the bench.
cue_captains_chair_knee_raise_1: Press forearms into pads and keep shoulders pushed down.
cue_captains_chair_knee_raise_2: Tuck knees high by curling your pelvis upward.
cue_captains_chair_knee_raise_mistake: Swinging back and forth on the pads.
cue_car_drivers_1: While standing upright, hold a barbell plate in both hands at the 3 and 9 o'clock positions.
cue_car_drivers_2: Initiate the movement by rotating the plate as far to one side as possible. Use the same type of movement you would use to turn a steering wheel to one side.
cue_car_drivers_mistake: Arching the lower back excessively instead of bracing.
cue_carioca_quick_step_1: Begin with your feet a few inches apart and your left arm up in a relaxed, athletic position.
cue_carioca_quick_step_2: With your right foot, quick step behind and pull the knee up.
cue_carioca_quick_step_mistake: Losing posture or landing stiffly with locked knees.
cue_cat_stretch_1: Position yourself on the floor on your hands and knees.
cue_cat_stretch_2: Pull your belly in and round your spine, lower back, shoulders, and neck, letting your head drop.
cue_cat_stretch_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_catch_and_overhead_throw_1: Begin standing while facing a wall or a partner.
cue_catch_and_overhead_throw_2: Using both hands, position the ball behind your head, stretching as much as possible, and forcefully throw the ball forward.
cue_catch_and_overhead_throw_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_chain_handle_extension_1: You will need two cable handle attachments and a flat bench, as well as chains, for this exercise.
cue_chain_handle_extension_2: Begin by extending through the elbow, keeping your upper arm still, with your wrists pronated.
cue_chain_handle_extension_mistake: Letting elbows flare or drift during the press.
cue_chain_press_1: Begin by connecting the chains to the cable handle attachments. Position yourself on the flat bench in the same position as for a dumbbell press.
cue_chain_press_2: Lower the chains by flexing the elbows, unloading some of the chain onto the floor.
cue_chain_press_mistake: Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_chair_leg_extended_stretch_1: Sit upright in a chair and grip the seat on the sides.
cue_chair_leg_extended_stretch_2: Raise one leg, extending the knee, flexing the ankle as you do so.
cue_chair_leg_extended_stretch_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_chair_lower_back_stretch_2: Bend to one side with your arm over your head. You can hold onto the chair with your free hand.
cue_chair_lower_back_stretch_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_chair_squat_1: To begin, first set the bar to a position that best matches your height.
cue_chair_squat_2: Take the bar with your hands facing forward, unlock it and lift it off the rack by extending your legs.
cue_chair_squat_mistake: Letting knees cave inward or heels lift off the floor.
cue_chair_upper_body_stretch_1: Sit on the edge of a chair, gripping the back of it.
cue_chair_upper_body_stretch_2: Straighten your arms, keeping your back straight, and pull your upper body forward so you feel a stretch. Hold for 20-30 seconds.
cue_chair_upper_body_stretch_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_chest_dip_1: Lean torso forward 20-30 degrees with elbows slightly flared.
cue_chest_dip_2: Lower until upper arms are parallel, then press up.
cue_chest_dip_mistake: Dropping too deep with rounded shoulders.
cue_chest_doorway_stretch_1: Rest your forearm on the frame and step through until the chest opens.
cue_chest_doorway_stretch_2: Keep the elbow at about shoulder height.
cue_chest_doorway_stretch_mistake: Shrugging the shoulder up toward the ear.
cue_chest_press_machine_1: Set the seat so the handles are mid-chest.
cue_chest_press_machine_2: Press out without locking the elbows hard.
cue_chest_press_machine_mistake: Lifting the shoulders off the pad.
cue_chest_push_from_3_point_stance_1: Begin in a three point stance, squatted down with your back flat and one hand on the ground. Place the medicine ball directly in front of you.
cue_chest_push_from_3_point_stance_2: To begin, take your first step as you pull the ball to your chest, positioning both hands to prepare for the throw.
cue_chest_push_from_3_point_stance_mista: Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_chest_push_multiple_response_1: Begin in a kneeling position facing a wall or utilize a partner. Hold the ball with both hands tight into the chest.
cue_chest_push_multiple_response_2: Execute the pass by exploding forward and outward with the hips while pushing the ball as hard as possible.
cue_chest_push_multiple_response_mistake: Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.

cue_close_grip_push_up_2: Lower chest to hands in a rigid plank, then press up.

cue_cocoons_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_concentration_curl_1: Brace the elbow against the inner thigh.
cue_concentration_curl_2: Curl slowly and squeeze at the top.
cue_concentration_curl_mistake: Swinging the shoulder to lift the weight.

cue_crunch_hands_overhead_1: Lie on the floor with your back flat and knees bent with around a 60-degree angle between the hamstrings and the calves.

cue_crunch_hands_overhead_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_crunch_legs_on_exercise_ball_1: Lie flat on your back with your feet resting on an exercise ball and your knees bent at a 90 degree angle.

cue_crunch_legs_on_exercise_ball_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_crunch_mistake: Pulling on the neck with the hands.

cue_dancers_stretch_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.

cue_db_calf_raise_1: Hold the dumbbells at your sides and rise high.
cue_db_calf_raise_2: Pause at the top and lower slowly.
cue_db_calf_raise_mistake: Bouncing quickly through a short range.
cue_db_external_rotation_1: Lie on your side with top elbow resting on your hip.
cue_db_external_rotation_2: Rotate light dumbbell upward smoothly and lower slowly.
cue_db_external_rotation_mistake: Dropping the elbow off your side or rolling back.
cue_db_floor_press_1: Bend knees with feet flat and keep elbows at 45 degrees.
cue_db_floor_press_2: Pause with triceps lightly resting on the floor.
cue_db_floor_press_mistake: Slamming elbows down or arching the lower back.
cue_db_fly_1: Lie on a bench with the dumbbells over the chest, elbows slightly bent.
cue_db_fly_2: Open the arms wide until the chest stretches, then bring them back.
cue_db_fly_mistake: Dropping too deep or straightening the elbows.
cue_db_front_raise_1: Keep torso upright with a soft bend in the elbows.

cue_db_front_raise_mistake: Swinging the hips to heave the weights up.

cue_db_incline_row_2: Row elbows back toward your hips, pausing at the top.
cue_db_incline_row_mistake: Shrugging upward instead of pulling back.
cue_db_lunge_1: Step forward and lower the back knee straight down.
cue_db_lunge_2: Keep the torso upright and the front foot flat.
cue_db_lunge_mistake: Letting the front knee cave in.
cue_db_preacher_curl_1: Keep the back of your upper arm flat on the pad.
cue_db_preacher_curl_2: Control the stretch at the bottom and curl smoothly.
cue_db_preacher_curl_mistake: Twisting the shoulder away from the pad.
cue_db_pullover_1: Keep ribs down and elbows softly bent as you reach back.
cue_db_pullover_2: Pull the dumbbell over the chest using lats and pecs.
cue_db_pullover_mistake: Flaring the ribcage and arching the lower back.

cue_db_reverse_lunge_2: Drive through the front heel to stand tall.
cue_db_reverse_lunge_mistake: Stepping too short and crowding the front knee.
cue_db_romanian_deadlift_1: Push the hips back and keep the dumbbells close to the legs.
cue_db_romanian_deadlift_mistake: Rounding the lower back to go deeper.
cue_db_row_1: Keep the back flat and pull the elbow toward the hip.
cue_db_row_2: Squeeze the shoulder blade, then lower slowly.
cue_db_row_mistake: Twisting the torso to swing the weight up.
cue_db_seated_one_leg_calf_raise_1: Balance a dumbbell vertically over the working knee.
cue_db_seated_one_leg_calf_raise_2: Lower heel deep and drive up onto the ball of your foot.
cue_db_shoulder_press_1: Sit tall with the core braced and press straight up.
cue_db_shoulder_press_2: Keep the wrists above the elbows.
cue_db_shoulder_press_mistake: Arching the lower back to press the weights.
cue_db_shrug_1: Let dumbbells hang at your sides with palms inward.
cue_db_shrug_2: Lift shoulders straight up and pause at the peak.
cue_db_shrug_mistake: Bouncing or jutting your head forward.
cue_db_side_bend_1: Bend straight to the side, not forward or back.
cue_db_side_bend_2: Lower slowly and return using the sides of the waist.
cue_db_side_bend_mistake: Using too heavy a weight and twisting.
cue_db_split_squat_1: Keep both feet planted in a staggered stance.
cue_db_split_squat_2: Lower straight down until back knee hovers above the floor.
cue_db_split_squat_mistake: Letting front heel lift off the ground.
cue_db_squat_1: Hold dumbbells at your sides with chest up and core tight.
cue_db_squat_2: Squat until thighs are parallel and drive through full feet.
cue_db_squat_mistake: Letting shoulders round forward with the weights.

cue_dead_bug_mistake: Letting a gap open under your lower back.

Shrugging shoulders up toward your ears.

cue_decline_push_up_1: Put the feet on a bench and the hands under the shoulders.

cue_decline_push_up_mistake: Piking the hips up or letting them sag.

cue_dip_2: Lower until the upper arms are about parallel.

cue_dip_machine_2: Push handles straight down through the heels of your palms.
cue_dip_machine_mistake: Shrugging shoulders up on the return.

cue_dips_triceps_version_mistake: Shrugging shoulders up toward your ears.

cue_dumbbell_clean_mistake: Rounding the lower back under load.

cue_dumbbell_raise_mistake: Arching the lower back excessively instead of bracing.

cue_dumbbell_scaption_mistake: Arching the lower back excessively instead of bracing.

cue_dumbbell_seated_box_jump_2: Plant your feet firmly on the ground as you lean forward, extending through the hips and knees to jump up and forward.
cue_dumbbell_seated_box_jump_mistake: Losing posture or landing stiffly with locked knees.
cue_dumbbell_squat_to_a_bench_1: Stand up straight with a flat bench behind you while holding a dumbbell on each hand (palms facing the side of your legs).
cue_dumbbell_squat_to_a_bench_2: Position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out.
cue_dumbbell_squat_to_a_bench_mistake: Letting knees cave inward or heels lift off the floor.
cue_dumbbell_tricep_extension_pronated_g: Lie down on a flat bench holding two dumbbells directly above your shoulders.
The palms of your hands should be facing forward, and your elbows should be tucked in. This will be your starting position.
Swinging the elbows forward to heave the weight.
cue_dynamic_back_stretch_1: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
cue_dynamic_back_stretch_2: Keeping your arms straight, swing them straight up in front of you 5-10 times, increasing the range of motion each time until your arms are above your head.
cue_dynamic_back_stretch_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_dynamic_chest_stretch_1: Stand with your hands together, arms extended directly in front of you. This will be your starting position.
cue_dynamic_chest_stretch_2: Keeping your arms straight, quickly move your arms back as far as possible and back in again, similar to an exaggerated clapping motion.
cue_dynamic_chest_stretch_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_elbow_circles_1: Sit or stand with your feet slightly apart.
cue_elbow_circles_2: Place your hands on your shoulders with your elbows at shoulder level and pointing out.
cue_elbow_circles_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_elbow_to_knee_1: Lie on the floor, crossing your right leg across your bent left knee. Clasp your hands behind your head, beginning with your shoulder blades on the ground.
cue_elbow_to_knee_2: Perform the motion by flexing the spine and rotating your torso to bring the left elbow to the right knee.
cue_elbow_to_knee_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_elbows_back_2: Place both hands on your lower back, fingers pointing downward and elbows out.
cue_elbows_back_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_elevated_back_lunge_1: Position a bar onto a rack at shoulder height loaded to an appropriate weight. Place a short, raised platform behind you.
cue_elevated_back_lunge_2: Rack the bar onto your upper back, keeping your back arched and tight. Step onto your raised platform with both feet. This will be your starting position.
cue_elevated_back_lunge_mistake: Letting the front knee collapse inward.
cue_elevated_cable_rows_1: Get a platform of some sort (it can be an aerobics or calf raise platform) that is around 4-6 inches in height.
cue_elevated_cable_rows_2: Place it on the seat of the cable row machine.
cue_elevated_cable_rows_mistake: Rounding the upper back or jerking the weight.
cue_elliptical_trainer_1: To begin, step onto the elliptical and select the desired option from the menu. Most ellipticals have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run.
cue_elliptical_trainer_2: The handles can be used to monitor your heart rate to help you stay at an appropriate intensity.
cue_elliptical_trainer_mistake: Losing posture or landing stiffly with locked knees.
cue_exercise_ball_crunch_1: Support your mid-to-lower back on the ball with feet wide.
cue_exercise_ball_crunch_2: Stretch over the ball slightly, then curl ribs to pelvis.
cue_exercise_ball_crunch_mistake: Bouncing off the ball to sit upright.
cue_exercise_ball_pull_in_1: Place an exercise ball nearby and lay on the floor in front of it with your hands on the floor shoulder width apart in a push-up position.
cue_exercise_ball_pull_in_2: Now place your lower shins on top of an exercise ball.
cue_exercise_ball_pull_in_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_extended_range_one_arm_kettlebell_fl: Lie on the floor and position a kettlebell for one arm to press. The kettlebell should be held by the handle.
Press the kettlebell by extending the elbow and adducting the arm, pressing it above your body. Return to the starting position.
Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_ez_bar_curl_1: Pin elbows by your sides and grip the angled handles.
cue_ez_bar_curl_2: Curl smoothly to shoulder height and lower for 2 seconds.
cue_ez_bar_curl_mistake: Swinging the hips or letting elbows drift forward.
cue_ez_bar_skull_crusher_1: Angle upper arms slightly back over your head for tension.
cue_ez_bar_skull_crusher_2: Lower the bar behind your forehead and extend without flaring.
cue_ez_bar_skull_crusher_mistake: Flaring elbows wide or dropping to the nose.
cue_face_pull_1: Pull the rope toward your face, elbows high.
cue_face_pull_2: Pull the hands apart and squeeze the rear shoulders.
cue_face_pull_mistake: Leaning back and using too much weight.
cue_farmers_carry_1: Stand tall with the shoulders down and the core tight.
cue_farmers_carry_mistake: Leaning to one side or shrugging.
cue_fast_skipping_1: Start in a relaxed position with one leg slightly forward. This will be your starting position.
cue_fast_skipping_2: Skip by executing a step-hop pattern of right-right-step to left-left-step, and so on, alternating back and forth.
cue_fast_skipping_mistake: Losing posture or landing stiffly with locked knees.
cue_figure_four_stretch_1: Lie on your back and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
cue_figure_four_stretch_2: Pull the bottom thigh toward your chest.
cue_figure_four_stretch_mistake: Lifting the head and tensing the neck.
cue_finger_curls_1: Hold a barbell with both hands and your palms facing up; hands spaced about shoulder width.
cue_finger_curls_2: Place your feet flat on the floor, at a distance that is slightly wider than shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
cue_finger_curls_mistake: Swinging the elbows forward to heave the weight.
cue_flat_bench_leg_pull_in_1: Lie on an exercise mat or a flat bench with your legs off the end.
cue_flat_bench_leg_pull_in_2: Place your hands either under your glutes with your palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench (or with palms down by the side on an exercise mat).
cue_flat_bench_leg_pull_in_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_flexed_arm_hang_1: Step or jump up so the chin is over the bar.
cue_flexed_arm_hang_2: Hold with the shoulders down and the body still.
cue_flexed_arm_hang_mistake: Letting the chin rest on the bar or the shoulders shrug up.
cue_flexor_incline_dumbbell_curls_1: Hold the dumbbell towards the side farther from you so that you have more weight on the side closest to you.
cue_flexor_incline_dumbbell_curls_2: Sit on an incline bench that is angled at 45-degrees while holding a dumbbell on each hand.
cue_flexor_incline_dumbbell_curls_mistak: Swinging the elbows forward to heave the weight.
cue_floor_glute_ham_raise_1: You can use a partner for this exercise or brace your feet under something stable.
cue_floor_glute_ham_raise_2: Begin on your knees with your upper legs and torso upright. If using a partner, they will firmly hold your feet to keep you in position.
cue_floor_glute_ham_raise_mistake: Rounding the lower back under load.
cue_floor_press_with_chains_1: Adjust the j-hooks so they are at the appropriate height to rack the bar.
cue_floor_press_with_chains_2: Begin lying on the floor with your head near the end of a power rack. Keeping your shoulder blades pulled together, pull the bar off of the hooks.
cue_floor_press_with_chains_mistake: Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_flutter_kicks_1: Keep lower back glued to the floor and chin slightly tucked.
cue_flutter_kicks_2: Alternate small, controlled kicks just above the floor.
cue_flutter_kicks_mistake: Arching the lower back when feet drop low.
cue_foot_smr_1: This exercise stretches the fascia of the muscles in the feet. Start off seated with your shoes removed.
cue_foot_smr_2: Press down firmly, rolling across the arch of your foot. Hold for 10-30 seconds, and then switch feet.
cue_foot_smr_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_frog_hops_1: Stand with your hands behind your head, and squat down keeping your torso upright and your head up. This will be your starting position.
cue_frog_hops_2: Jump forward several feet, avoiding jumping unnecessarily high. As your feet contact the ground, absorb the impact through your legs, and jump again.
cue_frog_hops_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_frog_sit_ups_1: Lie with your back flat on the floor (or exercise mat) and your legs extended in front of you.
cue_frog_sit_ups_2: Now bend at the knees and place your outer thighs by the floor (or mat) as you make the soles of your feet touch each other.
cue_frog_sit_ups_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_frog_stretch_1: On all fours, widen the knees and keep the feet turned out.
cue_frog_stretch_2: Rock the hips back slowly until the inner thighs stretch.
cue_frog_stretch_mistake: Pushing past a pinch in the knees.
cue_front_barbell_squat_to_a_bench_1: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes.
cue_front_barbell_squat_to_a_bench_2: Lift the bar off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.
cue_front_barbell_squat_to_a_bench_mista: Letting knees cave inward or heels lift off the floor.
cue_front_cone_hops_or_hurdle_hops_1: Set up a row of cones or other small barriers, placing them a few feet apart.
cue_front_cone_hops_or_hurdle_hops_2: Stand in front of the first cone with your feet shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
cue_front_cone_hops_or_hurdle_hops_mista: Losing posture or landing stiffly with locked knees.
cue_front_leg_raises_1: Stand next to a chair or other support, holding on with one hand.
cue_front_leg_raises_2: Swing your leg forward, keeping the leg straight. Continue with a downward swing, bringing the leg as far back as your flexibility allows.
cue_front_leg_raises_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_front_lever_row_1: Hold the tuck lever and row the body up.
cue_front_lever_row_2: Keep the hips level with the shoulders.
cue_front_lever_row_mistake: Dropping the hips as you pull.
cue_front_raise_and_pullover_1: Lie on a flat bench while holding a barbell using a palms down grip that is about 15 inches apart.
cue_front_raise_and_pullover_2: Place the bar on your upper thighs, extend your arms and lock them while keeping a slight bend on the elbows. This will be your starting position.
cue_front_raise_and_pullover_mistake: Pulling with momentum or stopping short of full range.
cue_front_squat_1: Rest the bar on the front of the shoulders with the elbows high.
cue_front_squat_2: Sit straight down, chest up, and drive up.
cue_front_squat_clean_grip_1: To begin, first set the bar in a rack slightly below shoulder level.
cue_front_squat_clean_grip_2: Lift the bar off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.
cue_front_squat_clean_grip_mistake: Swinging the elbows forward to heave the weight.
cue_front_squat_mistake: Dropping the elbows so the bar rolls forward.
cue_front_two_dumbbell_raise_1: Pick a couple of dumbbells and stand with a straight torso and the dumbbells on front of your thighs at arms length with the palms of the hand facing your thighs.
cue_front_two_dumbbell_raise_2: While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the dumbbells to the front with a slight bend on the elbow and the palms of the hands always facing down.
cue_front_two_dumbbell_raise_mistake: Arching the lower back excessively instead of bracing.
cue_gironda_sternum_chins_1: Grasp the pull-up bar with a shoulder width underhand grip.
cue_gironda_sternum_chins_2: Now hang with your arms fully extended and stick your chest out and lean back. Tip: You will be leaning back throughout the entire movement.
cue_gironda_sternum_chins_mistake: Rounding the upper back or jerking the weight.
cue_glute_ham_raise_1: Keep hips extended and torso straight as you lower.
cue_glute_ham_raise_2: Pull yourself back up by curling through the hamstrings.
cue_glute_ham_raise_mistake: Piking at the hips instead of flexing the knees.
cue_glute_kickback_1: Kneel on the floor or an exercise mat and bend at the waist with your arms extended in front of you (perpendicular to the torso) in order to get into a kneeling push-up position but with the arms spaced at shoulder width.
cue_glute_kickback_2: As you exhale, lift up your right leg until the hamstrings are in line with the back while maintaining the 90-degree angle bend.
cue_glute_kickback_mistake: Letting elbows flare or drift during the press.
cue_goblet_squat_1: Hold the bell at the chest and keep the elbows inside the knees.
cue_goblet_squat_2: Sit down between the hips with the chest tall.
cue_good_morning_1: Keep a soft knee bend and hinge the hips back.
cue_good_morning_2: Keep the back flat and the bar steady.
cue_good_morning_mistake: Rounding the back or squatting down.
cue_good_morning_off_pins_1: Begin with a bar on a rack at about the same height as your stomach.
cue_good_morning_off_pins_2: Begin the motion by extending through the hips with your glutes and hamstrings, and you are standing with the weight.
cue_good_morning_off_pins_mistake: Rounding the lower back under load.
cue_gorilla_chin_crunch_1: Hang from a chin-up bar using an underhand grip (palms facing you) that is slightly wider than shoulder width.
cue_gorilla_chin_crunch_2: Now bend your knees at a 90 degree angle so that the calves are parallel to the floor while the thighs remain perpendicular to it.
cue_gorilla_chin_crunch_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_groin_and_back_stretch_1: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet together.
cue_groin_and_back_stretch_2: Interlock your fingers behind your head. This will be your starting position.
cue_groin_and_back_stretch_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_groiners_1: Begin in a pushup position on the floor. This will be your starting position.
cue_groiners_2: Using both legs, jump forward landing with your feet next to your hands. Keep your head up as you do so.
cue_groiners_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_hack_squat_1: Keep the back and hips against the pad, feet shoulder-width apart.
cue_hack_squat_2: Lower until the thighs are level and push the platform away.
cue_hack_squat_mistake: Lifting the heels or locking the knees hard at the top.
cue_half_narrow_squat_1: Place the feet close together and keep the chest up.
cue_half_narrow_squat_2: Sit straight down, weight over the mid-foot.
cue_half_narrow_squat_mistake: Rising onto the toes or leaning far forward.
cue_half_squat_1: Sit the hips back and keep the heels on the floor.
cue_half_squat_2: Go to about half depth with the chest up.
cue_half_wide_squat_1: Set the feet wide and point the toes out a little.
cue_half_wide_squat_2: Push the knees out in line with the toes.
cue_hammer_curl_1: Hold the dumbbells with palms facing in.
cue_hammer_curl_2: Keep the elbows still and lower slowly.
cue_hammer_curl_mistake: Swinging the weights using the back.
cue_hammer_grip_incline_db_bench_press_1: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.
cue_hammer_grip_incline_db_bench_press_2: By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbells up, clean the dumbbells one arm at a time so that you can hold them at shoulder width.
cue_hammer_grip_incline_db_bench_press_m: Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_hamstring_smr_1: In a seated position, extend your legs over a foam roll so that it is position on the back of the upper legs.
cue_hamstring_smr_2: Using your hands, lift your hips off of the floor and shift your weight on the foam roll to one leg. Relax the hamstrings of the leg you are stretching.
cue_hamstring_smr_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_hamstring_stretch_1: Extend one leg with the heel down and hinge forward from the hips.
cue_hamstring_stretch_2: Keep the chest long and stop at a gentle pull.
cue_hamstring_stretch_mistake: Rounding the back to reach the toes.
cue_handstand_hold_1: Stack wrists, shoulders and hips in one line.
cue_handstand_hold_2: Squeeze the glutes and push the floor away.
cue_handstand_hold_mistake: Letting the ribs flare and the back arch.
cue_handstand_push_up_1: Lower the head to the floor with the body tight.
cue_handstand_push_up_2: Press up until the arms are straight.
cue_handstand_push_up_mistake: Arching the back to escape the hard part.
cue_hanging_bar_good_morning_1: Begin with a bar on a rack at about the same height as your stomach. Suspend the bar using chains or suspension straps.
cue_hanging_bar_good_morning_2: Bend over underneath the bar and rack the bar across the rear of your shoulders as you would a power squat, not on top of your traps.
cue_hanging_bar_good_morning_mistake: Rounding the lower back under load.
cue_hanging_knee_raise_1: Start from a calm hang and curl the hips up.
cue_hanging_knee_raise_mistake: Swinging the legs to build momentum.
cue_hanging_leg_raise_1: Keep the legs straight and tilt the pelvis up.
cue_hanging_leg_raise_2: Control the lowering all the way down.
cue_hanging_leg_raise_mistake: Swinging and using momentum instead of the abs.
cue_hanging_pike_1: Hang from a chin-up bar with your legs and feet together using an overhand grip (palms facing away from you) that is slightly wider than shoulder width.
cue_hanging_pike_2: Now bend your knees at a 90 degree angle and bring the upper legs forward so that the calves are perpendicular to the floor while the thighs remain parallel to it.
cue_hanging_pike_mistake: Pulling on the neck or using hip momentum.
cue_heavy_bag_thrust_1: Utilize a heavy bag for this exercise. Assume an upright stance next to the bag, with your feet staggered, fairly wide apart.
cue_heavy_bag_thrust_2: Begin by twisting at the waist, pushing the bag forward as hard as possible. Perform this move quickly, pushing the bag away from your body.
cue_heavy_bag_thrust_mistake: Losing posture or landing stiffly with locked knees.
cue_heel_touches_1: Lift shoulders slightly off the mat and keep chin neutral.
cue_heel_touches_2: Slide side to side reaching each hand toward the same heel.
cue_heel_walk_1: Walk on your heels with the toes pulled up.
cue_heel_walk_2: Take short, steady steps and keep upright.
cue_heel_walk_mistake: Letting the toes drop as you tire.
cue_high_cable_curl_1: Stand centered between high pulleys with upper arms parallel to floor.
cue_high_cable_curl_2: Curl handles toward your ears without dropping elbows.
cue_high_cable_curl_mistake: Dropping upper arms as you fatigue.
cue_high_row_machine_1: Brace chest against the pad and reach tall at the top.
cue_high_row_machine_2: Pull handles down and back, squeezing your lats.
cue_high_row_machine_mistake: Leaning away from the pad to finish.
cue_hip_bridge_1: Push through your heels and squeeze the glutes at the top.
cue_hip_bridge_2: Stop when hips and knees line up.
cue_hip_bridge_mistake: Arching the lower back instead of using the glutes.
cue_hip_circles_prone_1: Position yourself on your hands and knees on the ground. Maintaining good posture, raise one bent knee off of the ground. This will be your starting position.
cue_hip_circles_prone_2: Keeping the knee in a bent position, rotate the femur in an arc, attempting to make a big circle with your knee.
cue_hip_circles_prone_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_hip_extension_with_bands_1: Secure one end of the band to the lower portion of a post and attach the other to one ankle.
cue_hip_extension_with_bands_2: Facing the attachment point of the band, hold on to the column to stabilize yourself.
cue_hip_extension_with_bands_mistake: Rounding the lower back under load.
cue_hip_flexion_with_band_1: Secure one end of the band to the lower portion of a post and attach the other to one ankle.
cue_hip_flexion_with_band_2: Face away from the attachment point of the band.
cue_hip_flexion_with_band_mistake: Letting knees cave inward or heels lift off the floor.
cue_hip_flexor_stretch_1: Kneel on one knee and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
cue_hip_flexor_stretch_2: Shift the hips forward until the front of the hip feels long.
cue_hip_flexor_stretch_mistake: Leaning back instead of tucking the pelvis.
cue_hip_lift_with_band_1: After choosing a suitable band, lay down in the middle of the rack, after securing the band on either side of you.
cue_hip_lift_with_band_2: Adjust your position so that the band is directly over your hips. Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the floor.
cue_hip_lift_with_band_mistake: Rounding the lower back under load.
cue_hip_thrust_1: Chin tucked, drive through the heels, ribs down.
cue_hip_thrust_2: Squeeze the glutes hard at the top.
cue_hip_thrust_mistake: Overarching the lower back at the top.
cue_hollow_hold_1: Press the lower back into the floor.
cue_hollow_hold_2: Lift the shoulders and legs, arms by the ears.
cue_hollow_hold_mistake: Letting the lower back arch off the floor.
cue_hug_a_ball_2: Straddle an exercise ball between both legs and lower your hips down toward the floor.
cue_hug_a_ball_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_hug_knees_to_chest_1: Lie down on your back and pull both knees up to your chest.
cue_hug_knees_to_chest_2: Hold your arms under the knees, not over (that would put to much pressure on your knee joints).
cue_hug_knees_to_chest_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_hurdle_hops_1: Set up a row of hurdles or other small barriers, placing them a few feet apart.
cue_hurdle_hops_2: Stand in front of the first hurdle with your feet shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
cue_hurdle_hops_mistake: Losing posture or landing stiffly with locked knees.
cue_iliotibial_tract_smr_1: Lay on your side, with the bottom leg placed onto a foam roller between the hip and the knee. The other leg can be crossed in front of you.
cue_iliotibial_tract_smr_2: Place as much of your weight as is tolerable onto your bottom leg; there is no need to keep your bottom leg in contact with the ground.
cue_iliotibial_tract_smr_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_inchworm_1: Stand with your feet close together. Keeping your legs straight, stretch down and put your hands on the floor directly in front of you.
cue_inchworm_2: Begin by walking your hands forward slowly, alternating your left and your right. As you do so, bend only at the hip, keeping your legs straight.
cue_inchworm_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_incline_barbell_tricep_ext_1: Keep upper arms pointed slightly back on the incline bench.
cue_incline_barbell_tricep_ext_2: Lower behind your head for a deep triceps stretch.
cue_incline_barbell_tricep_ext_mistake: Moving upper arms forward and back.
cue_incline_bench_press_1: Set the bench to about 30 degrees with the shoulder blades back.
cue_incline_bench_press_2: Lower the bar to the upper chest and press up over the shoulders.
cue_incline_bench_press_mistake: Lifting the hips or letting the bar drift toward the face.
cue_incline_bench_pull_1: Grab a dumbbell in each hand and lie face down on an incline bench that is set to an incline that is approximately 30 degrees.
cue_incline_bench_pull_2: Let the arms hang to your sides fully extended as they point to the floor.
cue_incline_bench_pull_mistake: Rounding the upper back or jerking the weight.
cue_incline_cable_chest_press_1: Plant shoulder blades on the incline bench.
cue_incline_cable_chest_press_2: Press up and slightly inward over the upper chest.
cue_incline_cable_chest_press_mistake: Letting elbows drop below the bench line.
cue_incline_cable_fly_1: Set pulleys low and keep a slight elbow bend.
cue_incline_cable_fly_2: Bring hands together over your upper chest and pause.
cue_incline_chest_press_machine_1: Adjust the seat so handles align with upper chest.
cue_incline_chest_press_machine_2: Press smoothly without locking elbows harshly.
cue_incline_chest_press_machine_mistake: Letting shoulders roll forward off the backrest.
cue_incline_db_curl_1: Let the arms hang behind the body and curl up.
cue_incline_db_curl_2: Keep the elbows still and the shoulders back.
cue_incline_db_fly_1: Keep a soft, fixed bend in the elbows as arms open wide.
cue_incline_db_fly_2: Feel a chest stretch at shoulder level, then hug back up.
cue_incline_db_fly_mistake: Turning the fly into a press or dropping too low.
cue_incline_db_front_raise_1: Rest your back firmly against the incline pad.
cue_incline_db_front_raise_2: Lift smoothly to eye level and control the descent.
cue_incline_db_front_raise_mistake: Peeling your upper back off the bench.
cue_incline_db_press_1: Set the bench at a low incline and keep the shoulder blades back.
cue_incline_db_press_2: Press the dumbbells up and slightly together.
cue_incline_db_press_mistake: Setting the bench too steep so the shoulders take over.
cue_incline_diamond_knee_push_up_1: Make a diamond with your hands under the chest.
cue_incline_diamond_knee_push_up_2: Keep the elbows close and the body in one line.
cue_incline_diamond_knee_push_up_mistake: Letting the elbows flare or the hips sag.
cue_incline_dumbbell_bench_with_palms_fa: Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs. The palms of your hand will be facing each other.
By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbells up, clean the dumbbells one arm at a time so that you can hold them at shoulder width.
Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_incline_dumbbell_flyes_with_a_twist_: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lie on an incline bench that is set to an incline angle of no more than 30 degrees.
Extend your arms above you with a slight bend at the elbows.
Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_incline_hammer_curl_1: Let arms hang vertically behind your torso on the incline.
cue_incline_hammer_curl_2: Curl with neutral palms without pulling elbows forward.
cue_incline_hollow_plank_1: Tuck the tailbone and press the floor away.
cue_incline_hollow_plank_2: Ribs down, belly braced, body in one line.
cue_incline_hollow_plank_mistake: Letting the hips pike up or the lower back arch.
cue_incline_inner_biceps_curl_1: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lie back on an incline bench.
cue_incline_inner_biceps_curl_2: The dumbbells should be at arm's length hanging at your sides and your palms should be facing out. This will be your starting position.
cue_incline_inner_biceps_curl_mistake: Swinging the elbows forward to heave the weight.
cue_incline_push_up_1: Put the hands on a bench or table, body in one straight line.
cue_incline_push_up_2: Lower the chest to the edge and press back up.
cue_incline_push_up_depth_jump_1: For this drill you will need a box about 12 inches high, and two thick mats or aerobics steps.
cue_incline_push_up_depth_jump_2: Place the steps just outside of your shoulders, and place your feet on top of the box so that you are in an incline pushup position, your hands just inside the steps.
cue_incline_push_up_depth_jump_mistake: Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_incline_push_up_medium_1: Stand facing a Smith machine bar or sturdy elevated platform at an appropriate height.
cue_incline_push_up_medium_2: Place your hands on the bar, with your hands about shoulder width apart.
cue_incline_push_up_medium_mistake: Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_incline_push_up_mistake: Sagging hips or reaching with the chin.
cue_incline_push_up_wide_1: Stand facing a Smith machine bar or sturdy elevated platform at an appropriate height.
cue_incline_push_up_wide_2: Place your hands on the bar, with your hands wider than shoulder width.
cue_incline_push_up_wide_mistake: Flaring elbows too wide or bouncing at the bottom.
cue_incline_reverse_plank_1: Press the hips up until the body is one line.
cue_incline_reverse_plank_2: Keep the chest open and the neck relaxed.
cue_incline_reverse_plank_mistake: Sinking the hips toward the floor.
cue_intermediate_groin_stretch_1: Lie on your back with your legs extended. Loop a belt, rope, or band around one of your feet, and swing that leg as far to the side as you can.
cue_intermediate_groin_stretch_2: Pull gently on the belt to create tension in your groin and hamstring muscles. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and repeat on the other side.
cue_intermediate_groin_stretch_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_intermediate_hip_flexor_and_quad_str: Lie face down on the floor, with a rope, belt, or band looped around one foot.
Flex the knee and extend the hip of the leg to be stretched, using both hands to pull on the belt.
Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_internal_rotation_with_band_1: Choke the band around a post. The band should be at the same height as your elbow. Stand with your right side to the band a couple of feet away.
cue_internal_rotation_with_band_2: Grasp the end of the band with your right hand, and keep your elbow pressed firmly to your side.
cue_internal_rotation_with_band_mistake: Arching the lower back excessively instead of bracing.
cue_inverted_row_1: Hold a rigid plank from heels to head under the bar.
cue_inverted_row_2: Pull chest to the bar and squeeze shoulder blades together.
cue_inverted_row_mistake: Sagging the hips or leading with your chin.
cue_inverted_row_with_straps_1: Hang a rope or suspension straps from a rack or other stable object. Grasp the ends and position yourself in a supine position hanging from the ropes.
cue_inverted_row_with_straps_2: Begin by flexing the elbow, pulling your chest to your hands. Retract your shoulder blades as you perform the movement.
cue_inverted_row_with_straps_mistake: Rounding the upper back or jerking the weight.
cue_iron_cross_1: Set your posture and brace your core before starting.
cue_iron_cross_2: Move through a controlled full range of motion.
cue_iron_cross_mistake: Arching the lower back excessively instead of bracing.
cue_iron_crosses_stretch_1: Lie face down on the floor, with your arms extended out to your side, palms pressed to the floor. This will be your starting position.
cue_iron_crosses_stretch_2: To begin, flex one knee and bring that leg across the back of your body, attempting to touch it to the ground near the opposite hand.
cue_iron_crosses_stretch_mistake: Forcing the stretch into sharp pain or bouncing.
cue_iso_row_machine_1: Keep chest anchored on the pad and spine neutral.
cue_iso_row_machine_2: Drive elbows behind you and control the return.
cue_iso_row_machine_mistake: Twisting the torso on single-arm reps.
